description: This is a shell script used for testing `git rebase --skip` functionality within a Git project. It contains setup procedures, test cases, and checks related to rebasing, skipping commits, and related Git rebase behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines and executes a test case, expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in given output or files.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers a command to run after test completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the editor settings are unchanged after tests.
